Terms in this answer

Sarvashtakavarga सर्वाष्टकवर्ग
A score for each house from all seven planets' bindus. About 28 is average; 32 or more supports the house.
Dasamsa · D10 दशांश
The divisional chart read for career. A house lord strong here confirms the promise of that house.
Upachaya उपचय
Houses 3, 6, 10 and 11, which improve over time with effort.
Dusthana दुःस्थान
Houses 6, 8 and 12, read as places of difficulty or loss.
